title.narrative: SavED Recovery of Education - Ukraine 2024-2027 - SavED Recovery of Education Ukraine 2024-2027

description.narrative: Insatsen är primärt uppdelat i två delar och grupper av aktiviteter: Att stärka den operativa och programmatiska kapaciteten hos savED samt att stödja deras aktiviteter kring återställning av tillgång till lärande. Inom ramen för sina utbildningsprogram har savED tre huvudprodukter som kompletterar infrastrukturstödet - 1) strukturerade program för EduHives som ligger utanför läroplanen; 2) internt utvecklat program för återhämtning av lärandeförluster i grundläggande skolämnen; 3) UActive som är ett program för samhällsutbildning och engagemang för gymnasieelever. Den första komponenten av insatsen är utformad för att stärka savED:s operativa och programmatiska kapacitet för att leverera infrastrukturella och utbildningsprojekt mer effektivt. Sidas stöd kommer att hjälpa savEDs team att stärka sina operativa processer, förankra olika viktiga policyer och införa bästa förvaltningspraxis i NGO-sektorn. Den andra komponenten av insatsen är utformad för att stödja tillgång till fysiskt lärande i de krigsskadade ukrainska samhällena. savED planerar att stödja och utöka nätverket EduHives i Charkiv-, Mykolaiv- och Chernihiv-regionerna, där barn har varit inskrivna i ett onlineutbildningsformat sedan början av den fullskaliga invasionen. savED föreslår också att skala upp UActive i ytterligare en region, helst Kharkiv, men detta är beroende av säkerhetssituationen.

The intervention is primarily divided into two parts and groups of activities: Strengthening the operational and programmatic capacity of savED and supporting their activities on restoring access to learning. Within the framework of its education programmes, savED has three main products that equip the infrastructure support - 1) structured extracurricular programs for EduHives; 2) in-house developed learning loss recovery program in core school subjects; 3) UActive civic education and engagement program for high schoolers. The first component of the intervention is designed to strengthen savED's operational and programmatic capacity to deliver infrastructural and educational projects more effectively. Sida's support will assist savED's team in reinforcing its operational processes, entrenching various vital policies, and introducing best governance practices in the NGO sector. The second component of the intervention is designed to support access to face-to-face learning in the war-damaged Ukrainian communities. savED plans to support and extend the EduHives network in the Kharkiv, Mykolaiv and Chernihiv regions, where children have been enrolled in an online education format since the beginning of the full-scale invasion. Also, savED proposes to scale up UActive in one more region, preferably Kharkiv, but this is dependent on the security situation.

The overall objective of the intervention is to enhance savEDs operational, programmatic, and advocacy capacities to ensure efficient delivery of educational and infrastructural recovery initiatives while fostering organisational sustainability and resilience to meet the needs of war-affected communities in Ukraine.
First component, "Strengthening operational and programmatic capacity at savED":
Impact objective: - Strengthen the institutional capacity of savED so that the fund is able to fulfil its mission and scale its activities in a very shaky and unpredictable environment in Ukraine, as well as in a volatile international milieu.
Outcome 1: - Improved sustainability, organizational capacity, strategic and operational efficiency of savED.
Outcome 2: - Enhanced skills and competencies of savED staff.
Outcome 3: - Increased reach and impact of infrastructural and educational programs.
Outcome 4: - Robust monitoring and evaluation systems are in place.
Second component, "Supporting savEDs activities around the recovery of access to learning":
Impact objective 1: - Children from frontline and de-occupied communities have access to face-to-face educational activities, allowing them to recover and enhance their academic knowledge, communication and other soft skills.
Outcome 1.1: - Supporting the existence of already established EduHives in the Kharkiv, Chernihiv and Mykolaiv regions.
Outcome 1.2: - Establishing new EduHives to promote education and socialization among children.
Impact objective 2: - High school students foster their knowledge and skills in civic leadership, project management, and collective problem-solving skills. They thus are able to contribute to the recovery and improvement of lives in their home communities.
Outcome 2.1: - Implement the UActive program in the Kharkiv region and support the implementation of at least 10 local social projects by local teenagers.
Impact objective 3: - Local teachers are trained in psycho-emotional support and stress management techniques, which enhance the quality of the educational process and improve interactions with students.
Outcome 3.1: - Implement the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) program for local educators.

tag.narrative: 4.1 - By 2030, ensure that all girls and boys complete free, equitable and quality primary and secondary education leading to relevant and effective learning outcomes.
4.1 - Senast 2030 säkerställa att alla flickor och pojkar fullbordar avgiftsfri och likvärdig grundskole- och gymnasieutbildning av god kvalitet som leder till relevanta och ändamålsenliga kunskaper.

4.5 - By 2030, eliminate gender disparities in education and ensure equal access to all levels of education and vocational training for the vulnerable, including persons with disabilities, indigenous peoples and children in vulnerable situations.

4.5 - Senast 2030 avskaffa skillnaderna mellan könen inom utbildningsområdet och säkerställa lika tillgång till utbildning och yrkesutbildning på alla nivåer för utsatta personer, inklusive personer med funktionsnedsättning, ursprungsfolk och barn som lever under utsatta förhållanden.

4.7 - By 2030, ensure that all learners acquire the knowledge and skills needed to promote sustainable development, including, among others, through education for sustainable development and sustainable lifestyles, human rights, gender equality, promotion of a culture of peace and non-violence, global citizenship and appreciation of cultural diversity and of culture’s contribution to sustainable development.

4.7 - Senast 2030 säkerställa att alla studerande får de kunskaper och färdigheter som behövs för att främja en hållbar utveckling, bland annat genom utbildning för hållbar utveckling och hållbara livsstilar, mänskliga rättigheter, jämställdhet, främjande av en kultur av fred, icke-våld och globalt medborgarskap samt värdesättande av kulturell mångfald och kulturens bidrag till hållbar utveckling.
